title: Comparing Figures in a Report: összevetve, felülmúlva
goal: I can compare figures in an economic report with a participle (*összevetve a tavalyi évvel, a várakozásokat felülmúlva*).
I can name the main indicators (*bruttó hazai termék, bázishatás, reálbér-növekedés*).
I can say that a figure is above or below a forecast.

sections.title: Unit 13: Macroeconomic Architecture, Fiscal Policy & Monetary Stance
body: Economic reports and the news about the economy use fixed words for figures (*bázishatás*, *reálkamat*), long sentences with clauses of concession (*noha a keresleti nyomás enyhült, ...*) and participles that open the sentence.
This unit follows Kornai János's book *A hiány* (1980). You will learn to read and write about growth, interest rates, debt and inflation, and to explain Kornai's idea of the soft budget constraint.
